text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri hails new electoral law issued at the request of King Hassan for fair polls.
- Moroccan Hicham Arazi wins Hassan II Grand Prix tennis tournament.
- Al-Qods committee final statement made public on Saturday urges Arab countries to review ties with Israel.
- Parliament to close extraordinary session on Monday after it approves new electoral code.
- Talk about government reshuffle raises speculation.
- Moroccan Human Rights Organisation (OMDH) adopts three-year action strategy to bring women and children more into consideration and to underline independance.
- According to the Industrial Development Office (ODI), the northern city of Tangier, in which a new free trade zone is planned, lacks infrastructure likely to attract investors.
